name: Irrevocable co-signature escrow DEVELOPMENT
provenance: Independent T17 second DEVELOPMENT oracle; source-authored after first generation green and before any second candidate output. Awaiting parent contract review before generation.
requirements: An initiator offers one unit from a shared two-unit allowance into escrow. The counterparty can sign, wait, veto with a full refund and terminal failure, or stop with escrow forfeiture. Before signing the initiator can cancel with full refund and offer again; after signing cancellation is denied for both actors. Only the initiator can release a signed offer, consuming the escrowed unit and succeeding with the other unit still available. Stop forfeits any escrow and fails; horizon fails without a release or implicit refund. Fixed actor order, static private facts, no communication, no external operations. This independently supplied finite table is a prerequisite, not proof that natural-language intent was independently understood.
